intro.text: An unarmed guard at Mercystar's palace, named after his father, whose only duty is to stop anyone wandering in to disturb the goddess while she sleeps.

items.text: Gagaril and Fran are on duty, and alert though they have little to fear, when Vasher, posing as a madman, comes up to them. They treat him kindly, but he still needs to get past, so he chokes Gagaril unconscious with Awakened cloak tassels, leaving him otherwise unharmed.
Questioning the guards, Lightsong teases Gagaril about his name, asking whether his father was drunk when he picked it, then sends him and Fran to stand apart so he can check each account separately.

appearance.text: He wears an extravagant costume in Mercystar's colours, and carries no weapon, since no one in Hallandren expects anyone to attack a Returned.
